🆕 NEW RELEASE: Greetings From California is back as a Good Charlotte album

The 2014 album first came out as The Madden Brothers and left streaming a year later. Now Joel and Benji Madden have reissued it under the Good Charlotte name, with three bonus tracks and a limited 2-LP set planned for Record Store Day on 27 November.
